verdict.rationale: Customer.io ships AI features (an agent, MCP server and CLI), so a buyer could fairly ask whether customer data is excluded from AI model training. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a training opt-out or a no-training commitment. Related items such as synthetic email relays for data residency, audit logs, and MCP read/write permission categories are different controls and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
